01-briefing.png.textSnippet: Here is what this hour holds, in order. First a short look around this website, which takes about seven minutes. Then the studio code: six real situations, and you decide whether each one is in line w
01-briefing.png.contentAnchor: Here is what this hour holds, in order. First a short look around this website, which takes about seven minutes. Then the studio code: six real situations, and you decide whether each one is in line with the code or against it. Then Portfolio Zero, which is twelve quick questions about where you are starting from, and it is not a test. Then your Compass, which asks what kind of work you actually enjoy. It finishes with a card about where the year goes next, one marked question, and a screen that asks you how the hour went.
01-briefing.png.says: the opening card, including what January's options actually mean

02-orientation.png.contentAnchor: Look along the top of this screen, over on the right, for a small green word: Saved. You never press a save button here. Every time you answer something or finish a part of a lesson, this website writes it to your own record, and that green word tells you it has landed. Your work follows your login, so you can pick it up on any school computer.

03-code-intro.png.contentAnchor: A working studio writes its rules down as a code of conduct, and then somebody has to decide whether people are keeping it. Today that somebody is you. You will read six real situations. For each one you decide whether it is IN LINE with the code or AGAINST it, and if it is against it, which standard it breaks.
